target_customer: SaaS sales, pre-sales and customer success teams that give live product demos
problem: Reps forget talking points during live demos; Demo Gorilla shows notes that follow the feature on screen and syncs notes to the CRM.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat browser extension

founders.name: Manu Zope
founders.background_notes: Software engineer at PagerDuty 2014 to 2019 and engineering manager at Sentry 2019 to 2022 per YC page, which lists him as sole founder.

competitors.name: Walnut
competitors.what: Platform for building interactive product demos with a Chrome extension, with analytics
competitors.traction_then: Customers included Dell, Adobe and NetApp
competitors.funding_then: US$35M Series B in January 2022 after a US$21M Series A

competitors.name: Demostack
competitors.what: Product demo creation platform for sales teams
competitors.funding_then: US$34M Series B in April 2022 per CB Insights, which is a few months after the batch

technical_complexity.rationale: A browser extension that detects page context and syncs notes with a CRM is ordinary web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Well-funded demo platforms already served the same buyers and the extension is easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented in the sources read.

market_need_then: Demo tooling attracted large rounds in early 2022 (Walnut and Demostack), showing buyer spend, though no direct demand evidence for presenter notes was found.

identity.logo: Logo shown on the site; details not described by the page
identity.mascot_or_character: Gorilla implied by the name; no mascot description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Playful tagline Make your SaaS Demos awesome

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable animal name with an exact .com, but no press, community or merch about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Demo Gorilla was a solo-founder YC Winter 2022 company in a crowded demo software category where Walnut and Demostack had just raised large rounds. YC lists it inactive although the site still loads, and no shutdown report was found, so the cause of inactivity is not public.
notes: The US$500K pre-seed rests on aggregators (VCBacked dates it January 2022; CB Insights shows 2022-03-30) and no outlet or filing; the date is therefore uncertain. CB Insights names other founders (Henri Liriani, Jonathan Friedman), which conflicts with the YC page and looks like a data mixup, so they are not listed. Founding year 2021 from one source versus 2022 on Employbl. Site is live but YC lists the company inactive, so exit is unknown.
